Use case: product-mockup, identity-preserving macro photography. Make ONE square editorial detail photograph for the Velantra Vivienne homepage. The attached image is the sole PRODUCT IDENTITY reference: the owner-selected September 3 Chocolate Vivienne master. It establishes intended visible design, not factory measurement or certification. The requested view is a TIGHT CROP of an existing visible surface, not a whole-bag view, a new design, a new camera orbit, or an assembly diagram. Keep the same dark chocolate pore grain, soft slouch and natural folds, smoother warmer cognac-brown contrast trim, dark brown thread, edge thickness and local sheen wherever visible. Preserve the selected master geometry in the visible crop; never add a feature merely because it was described outside that crop. Photorealistic 100 mm macro lens, elegant warm-neutral atelier editorial light: broad soft window light from upper left, gentle fill, soft realistic highlights and deep but readable contact shadows, neutral cream only where background is visible. True fine surface detail, quiet restrained color, no orange filter, no plastic CGI polish. No people, hands, tools, machines, labels, logos, text, watermark, certification marks, dimension markings, new compartments, interior, backside or invented hardware. No white contrast stitching, no canvas, no suede. Deliver one finished square image with no border or collage.

SPECIFIC SHOT: TIGHT MACRO of the LEFT ROLLED HANDLE ROOT and nearby finished leather edge visible on the selected master front. Frame only the lower few centimeters of the round rolled handle as it joins its pointed stitched attachment tab, the two existing small gold rivets and the slim neatly finished dark edge of that tab over the upper leather band. The curved handle tube exits through the top of the image; no entire handle arch or whole handbag. Preserve the tab silhouette, paired rivet placement, dark edge paint, fine tonal stitches and the grained-vs-smooth leather contrast exactly. View stays on the visible FRONT of the bag, never inside or behind. The dark chocolate and cognac surfaces fill most of the frame; a sliver of neutral background is optional.
